user.title: Choose the shop
user.description: Where do you shop? With REMA 1000 you log in and get prices on every item, REMA's recipes and the shopping list in the REMA app. With another shop its offer catalogue is used, and the shopping list is kept in Home Assistant. The shop can be changed later under Reconfigure.

migrate.title: Move your REMA 1000 setup
migrate.description: There is a setup of the old REMA 1000 integration for {account}. Submit to move it to Middagsro with its meal plans, settings, recipe collection and entities (they keep their IDs). You don't have to log in again.

rema.title: Log in to REMA 1000
rema.description: Use the same e-mail and password as on rema1000.dk and in the REMA 1000 app. Items are always added to your primary shopping list, the one shown in the app.

no_ai_task.title: No AI Task for Middagsro
no_ai_task.description:
Middagsro makes meal plans with an AI Task entity, but none was found.

Set up an AI service that offers AI Tasks, for example Google Generative AI, OpenAI or Ollama (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration). Then choose it under Settings in the Middagsro panel, or set a preferred AI Task in Home Assistant. An AI that only offers a conversation agent (such as LiteLLM) can be chosen there too.

This message goes away by itself the next time a meal plan is made.
